title: Concept: Chronograf console is reachable without authentication
description: Chronograf is the administrative front end for an InfluxDB estate, with saved connections and alert rules. An unauthenticated console lets the caller finish the setup as an administrator or reuse an existing connection if one is stored.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller reaches the metrics store through Chronograf and can change alert rules that the operations team relies on.
